title: UI reconcilePendingPrompts ignores isEngramRetained / engramInterrupted changes, so a now-historical row stays selectable for Resume
outcome: When the backend flips isEngramRetained or engramInterrupted on an existing prompt id, the client adopts the new projection, so canSelectPlainQueueHead no longer offers a selection Resume that the backend refuses.
acceptance: UI reconcilePendingPrompts ignores isEngramRetained / engramInterrupted changes, so a now-historical row stays selectable for Resume is done
